Greg Thomas is a 1985 graduate of Hamilton College and an astute observer of the current jazz scene. His writing has appeared in the Village Voice and the London Guardian Observer, and he was founding Editor-in-Chief of Harlem World magazine. Greg and his wife, Jewel Kinch-Thomas, currently promote jazz events through their company, G&J Productions.
Greg was interviewed in Clinton, New York on October 11, 2014, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are in the Jazz Archive at Hamilton College talking to Greg Thomas, Hamilton class of ’85. And I should tell you that I have described you as a jazz entrepreneur.
Do you like that? Because I wasn’t quite sure. I know I’m aware of some of the things you’ve done but probably not all. But you are a person that got bit by the jazz bug.
